GREATER PADUCAH ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT

Paducah Delivers Real Results

Greater Paducah Economic Development is a public/private partnership formed to attract and grow jobs and investment through assisting existing business with expansion projects and recruiting new businesses.

PADUCAH CONVENTION CENTER

Paducah Convention Center

The beautiful, newly renovated Julian Carroll Convention Center encompaasses more than 65,000 square feet of premium convention space, including the 20,000 square foot River Ballroom, which can be divided into separate meeting areas. Smaller venues are available for groups of 30 or less. There are as many as 20 separate spaces at your disposal inside our riverside convention center.
Click Here

MCCRACKEN COUNTY FISCAL COURT MEETING

Recent Fiscal Court Meeting

The McCracken County Fiscal Court meets the second and fourth Mondays each month at 5pm. Meetings occur in court room D on the first floor of the McCracken County Courthouse.
